items.title: Rudolph Beaulieu Interview, 1961-05-31
items.q: Sergeant Morris, another one, he wanted to throw my money in the canal when I finished playing.

ctx.x: I was playing on a job when he fell back off the camp and broke his leg. Really? Sergeant Morris, another one, he wanted to throw my money in the canal when I finished playing. Well there's always a good fellow in the crowd. I said, I come along and he said, why don't you have to invite them boys and play it all day for you? What you want to throw that money on in that lake? Put them caps on the water. If you'd thrown it down in the lake, you could look right down there, watch how clear that water was. You could…
Huh? It's going to make you die in the water for him.
